description: JavaScript demo for generating QR codes, including functions for rendering QR codes on canvas or SVG, handling user input, and displaying QR code statistics.

methods.name: redrawQrCode
methods.description: Main function to generate and display QR code based on user input, supporting both bitmap and SVG output.

methods.name: getInputErrorCorrectionLevel
methods.description: Determines the error correction level based on selected radio buttons.

methods.name: describeSegments
methods.description: Provides a textual description of QR code segments.

methods.name: countUnicodeChars
methods.description: Counts Unicode code points in a UTF-16 string.

methods.name: handleVersionMinMax
methods.description: Adjusts QR code version range based on user input and triggers QR code redraw.
